final: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, AVG(order_count * 1.0 / total_orders) AS average_share, AVG(order_count * 1.0 / total_orders - average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order") AS total_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM "order") / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order") AS average_share FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order") > (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM "order"))
